headline: HSBC Expert: Year-End Exchange Rate Pressure Does Not Come From One Side Alone
summary: HSBC says strong export and import growth is raising demand for foreign currency. This could make the USD/VND exchange rate more sensitive toward the end of 2026.
why: The dong is Vietnam's currency, and its exchange rate reflects trade flows, capital movements and central bank policy. Trade-driven dollar demand can pressure the currency.
